static_traits.name: 夏洁
static_traits.family_status: Parents live in Florida; my elder brother currently stays at her home and lives together with her
static_traits.social_status: 有少量朋友与家人可交谈，但尚not yet就此问题与他们沟通
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体问题；此前not yet寻求心理治疗；过往not yet出现类似问题
static_traits.language_features: 配合度较好，表达清晰连贯，能识do nottrigger因素；语气偏消极，倾向自我批评；对“积极自我对话”持怀疑态度

basic_info.main_problem: I tend to focus on the negative parts of situations, leading to feelings of disappointment and self-criticism.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that my focus on the negative has affected my emotions and relationships, so I am seeking counseling at this time.

special_situations.event: Overcooked the pasta slightly when cooking with older brother
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果事情have not做到完美，就意味着失败并让他人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets higher standards and over-controls the steps; afterward engages in self-criticism to push themselves that 'next time must be perfect'

special_situations.event: Baking a cake with the elder brother ended in failure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要出现错误，整个经历就not值得；积极部分not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 只盯着出错之处回放并negate正面体验，试图通过苛责自己来避免再次犯错
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Messing up means the whole thing is terrible

special_situations.event: 当事情have not按计划进行
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a deviation occurs, things will inevitably get worse afterward
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Envisions the worst case in advance and stays highly vigilant in an attempt to control risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次not顺利，接下来也会出问题

special_situations.event: Small mistakes or conflicts arise when interacting with older brother
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果发生not如意，我应为全部后果负责
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Takes responsibility onto oneself and loses one's temper with one's older brother to release pressure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault，他会怪我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to stay close to his elder brother, be recognized, and have a harmonious experience together
core_conflict.fear: Fears being criticized and disappointing others because of mistakes, relationships damaged as a result
defense_goal: 通过追求完美与自我苛责来避免错误与被negate
把紧张与not满Displacement到次要目标以缓解Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: A self-blamer needing perfection to be accepted
object_relations.object_representation: Significant others (older brother/relatives) are judges who may be disappointed or critical

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当与兄长共同活动出现失误或被讨论“哪里做得not够好”时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将小失误视为全面失败，并认为兄长会责怪自己（移情：把过往被评判的体验Projection到当前关系）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气急促、易烦躁；将not满指向兄长或次要话题，use“It is all my fault”“你看吧”之类短句，回避具体事实探讨。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to let go of perfect standards and try a more neutral or realistic perspective
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 体验为“如果not坚持高标准就会失控”，将外界的“必须完美”的规则当作自己的准则
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 频繁use“应该/必须”句式，自责语气，强调规则与标准，弱化感受层面的探索。

manifestations: High expectations and the 'must be perfect' condition of worth limit choices and spontaneity
Fear of making mistakes leads to rigid control of daily activities
outcomes: Increased anxiety and feelings of shame

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: In counseling, frequently criticizes oneself and worries about making mistakes
Skeptical toward new perspectives, expresses feelings cautiously

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Treats perfectionist rules as the only correct way

positive_force: Willing to try restructuring and homework (says he can give it a try)
能识do nottrigger情境（事情not按计划时）
Has positive experiences in the relationship with the older brother (cooking and baking together)
Has some social support (friends and family to talk to)
negative_force: Fearing mistakes and tending toward catastrophic predictions
Self-criticizes and takes emotions out on the elder brother

antecedent: Small mishaps occur in shared activities with the older brother (such as cooking, baking)
target_behavior.core_reason: High expectations and fear of making mistakes lead to equating small slip-ups with total failure
target_behavior.function: Avoids failure and shame, seeks a sense of safety through cognitive control
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood、羞耻、自我批评；影响与兄长关系与活动的乐趣

antecedent: After making a mistake during a shared activity
When feeling the threat of failure or criticism
target_behavior.core_reason: 将对失败的Anxiety与自责转化为对外的发泄（防御性Displacement）
target_behavior.function: 释放紧张与not适，短暂减轻内在压力
target_behavior.consequence: 与兄长Relationship tension，沟通质量下降
